content:
Access and study the full prompts & assets from Seedance 2.0 pro-creator projects to learn shot construction and workflow, then remix those prompts for your own videos.  
Write your Seedance prompt as a shot-by-shot breakdown with exact timestamps (e.g., Shot 1 0–3s, Shot 2 3–5s) to control pacing and scene progression.  
Specify camera language per shot (low static shot, close-up, wide reveal, fast vertical tilt, low dutch-angle, whip-pan, fast orbit, pull back) to drive consistent cinematography.  
Call out editing style explicitly (rapid three-frame cut, hard cuts, no transition, slow motion, extreme close-up slow motion) to control transitions and time effects.  
Include lighting and environment constraints (overcast daylight through windows on the right, cool grey-teal classroom, cold blue-grey light) to keep continuity across shots.  
Add concrete action beats and physical interactions (overturned desks, floor tiles cracking, impact throws character through desk, papers scattering) to increase motion clarity and impact.  
Embed dialogue with language tags and translations inside the relevant shot to synchronize performance (e.g., Japanese lines + English translation).

es.content:
Accede y estudia los prompts completos y los assets de los proyectos pro-creator de Seedance 2.0 para aprender la construcción de planos y el flujo de trabajo, y luego remezcla esos prompts para tus propios videos.  
Escribe tu prompt de Seedance como un desglose plano por plano con timestamps exactos (por ejemplo, Shot 1 0–3s, Shot 2 3–5s) para controlar el ritmo y la progresión de la escena.  
Especifica el lenguaje de cámara por plano (low static shot, close-up, wide reveal, fast vertical tilt, low dutch-angle, whip-pan, fast orbit, pull back) para lograr una cinematografía consistente.  
Indica explícitamente el estilo de edición (rapid three-frame cut, hard cuts, no transition, slow motion, extreme close-up slow motion) para controlar las transiciones y los efectos de tiempo.  
Incluye restricciones de iluminación y entorno (overcast daylight through windows on the right, cool grey-teal classroom, cold blue-grey light) para mantener la continuidad entre planos.  
Añade beats de acción concretos e interacciones físicas (overturned desks, floor tiles cracking, impact throws character through desk, papers scattering) para aumentar la claridad del movimiento y el impacto.  
Incorpora diálogo con etiquetas de idioma y traducciones dentro del plano correspondiente para sincronizar la interpretación (por ejemplo, líneas en japonés + traducción al inglés).

fr.content:
Accédez aux prompts complets et aux assets des projets Seedance 2.0 pro-creator pour apprendre la construction des plans et le workflow, puis remixez ces prompts pour vos propres vidéos.  
Rédigez votre prompt Seedance sous forme de découpage plan par plan avec des timestamps exacts (par ex. Plan 1 0–3 s, Plan 2 3–5 s) afin de contrôler le rythme et la progression des scènes.  
Précisez le langage caméra pour chaque plan (plan fixe en contre-plongée, gros plan, plan large de révélation, tilt vertical rapide, angle hollandais en contre-plongée, whip-pan, orbite rapide, recul de caméra) pour obtenir une cinématographie cohérente.  
Indiquez explicitement le style de montage (cut rapide en trois images, cuts francs, aucune transition, ralenti, très gros plan en ralenti) pour contrôler les transitions et les effets temporels.  
Incluez des contraintes d’éclairage et d’environnement (lumière du jour couverte à travers les fenêtres à droite, salle de classe gris-vert froid, lumière bleu-gris froide) pour maintenir la continuité entre les plans.  
Ajoutez des beats d’action concrets et des interactions physiques (bureaux renversés, carreaux du sol qui se fissurent, l’impact projette le personnage à travers un bureau, papiers qui s’éparpillent) pour renforcer la clarté du mouvement et l’impact.  
Intégrez les dialogues avec des balises de langue et leurs traductions dans le plan concerné afin de synchroniser la performance (par ex. répliques en japonais + traduction anglaise).

ja.content:
Seedance 2.0 pro-creator プロジェクトの完全な prompt とアセットにアクセスして精査し、ショット構成とワークフローを学び、その prompt を自分の動画用にリミックスしましょう。  
Seedance の prompt は、正確なタイムスタンプ付きのショットごとの分解として書きます（例: Shot 1 0–3s、Shot 2 3–5s）。これにより、テンポとシーンの進行をコントロールできます。  
各ショットごとにカメラ言語を指定します（low static shot、close-up、wide reveal、fast vertical tilt、low dutch-angle、whip-pan、fast orbit、pull back など）。これにより、一貫したシネマトグラフィを実現できます。  
編集スタイルも明示的に記述します（rapid three-frame cut、hard cuts、no transition、slow motion、extreme close-up slow motion など）。これにより、トランジションや時間効果をコントロールできます。  
ライティングと環境の制約も含めます（右側の窓から差し込む曇天の昼光、クールなグレー・ティールの教室、冷たい青灰色の光など）。これにより、ショット間の連続性を保てます。  
具体的なアクションのビートと物理的なインタラクションも追加します（倒れた机、床タイルのひび割れ、衝撃でキャラクターが机を突き破って吹き飛ぶ、紙が散乱する など）。これにより、動きの明瞭さとインパクトが増します。  
パフォーマンスを同期させるため、関連するショット内に言語タグと翻訳付きのセリフを埋め込みます（例: 日本語の台詞 + 英語訳）。

ko.content:
Seedance 2.0 프로 크리에이터 프로젝트의 전체 prompt와 assets에 접근해 학습하면 shot 구성과 workflow를 익힐 수 있으며, 그런 다음 그 prompt들을 자신의 영상에 맞게 remix할 수 있습니다.  
Seedance prompt는 정확한 타임스탬프가 포함된 shot-by-shot breakdown 형식으로 작성해 pacing과 scene progression을 제어하세요. 예: Shot 1 0–3s, Shot 2 3–5s  
각 shot마다 camera language를 구체적으로 지정해 일관된 cinematography를 이끌어내세요. (low static shot, close-up, wide reveal, fast vertical tilt, low dutch-angle, whip-pan, fast orbit, pull back)  
editing style도 명시적으로 적어 transitions와 time effects를 제어하세요. (rapid three-frame cut, hard cuts, no transition, slow motion, extreme close-up slow motion)  
lighting과 environment 제약도 포함해 shot 간 continuity를 유지하세요. (오른쪽 창문을 통해 들어오는 흐린 낮빛, 차갑고 회청색 톤의 교실, 차가운 blue-grey light)  
구체적인 action beat와 physical interaction을 추가해 motion의 명확성과 임팩트를 높이세요. (뒤집힌 책상, 바닥 타일이 갈라짐, 충격으로 캐릭터가 책상을 뚫고 날아감, 종이가 흩날림)  
관련된 shot 안에 language tag와 번역을 함께 넣어 dialogue를 삽입하면 performance를 동기화할 수 있습니다. (예: 일본어 대사 + 영어 번역)

pt.content:
Acesse e estude os prompts completos e os assets dos projetos Seedance 2.0 pro-creator para aprender construção de cenas e workflow, e depois remixe esses prompts para os seus próprios vídeos.  
Escreva seu prompt do Seedance como uma divisão cena a cena, com timestamps exatos (por exemplo, Cena 1 0–3s, Cena 2 3–5s) para controlar o ritmo e a progressão das cenas.  
Especifique a linguagem de câmera por cena (low static shot, close-up, wide reveal, fast vertical tilt, low dutch-angle, whip-pan, fast orbit, pull back) para manter uma cinematografia consistente.  
Indique explicitamente o estilo de edição (rapid three-frame cut, hard cuts, no transition, slow motion, extreme close-up slow motion) para controlar transições e efeitos de tempo.  
Inclua restrições de iluminação e ambiente (overcast daylight through windows on the right, cool grey-teal classroom, cold blue-grey light) para manter a continuidade entre as cenas.  
Adicione beats de ação concretos e interações físicas (overturned desks, floor tiles cracking, impact throws character through desk, papers scattering) para aumentar a clareza do movimento e o impacto.  
Incorpore diálogos com tags de idioma e traduções dentro da cena relevante para sincronizar a performance (por exemplo, falas em japonês + tradução em inglês).
